organization: Association neuchâteloise pour le bien des aveugles
description: First professional position as a social worker after graduating from the University of Neuchâtel.

role: Social worker (assistante sociale), including guardianship/curatorship mandates
organization: Service social et médico-social des Franches-Montagnes
description: Social and medico-social work focused on social assistance, child protection and integration measures; held curatorship (curatrice) mandates.

organization: Services sociaux régionaux du canton du Jura
description: Continued social work within the regional social services of the canton of Jura until entering full-time cantonal government.

role: Cantonal government minister, Head of the Department of Education, Culture and Sport
organization: Government of the Canton of Jura
description: Member of the Jura cantonal executive for thirteen years; directed education, culture and sport policy. President of the cantonal government in 2006, 2008 and 2012. President of the Conference of Public Education Ministers of Latin Switzerland (2009–2013).

organization: School of Social Work and Health (HETSL), Lausanne
description: Directed the HETSL (Haute École de travail social et de la santé) in Lausanne. Official FDHA biography gives the period as 2016–2020; some press sources cite 2015–2019.

role: President of the Federal Film Commission
description: Served as President of the Federal Film Commission.

role: Member of the Council of States for the canton of Jura
description: Represented Jura in the upper house. Chaired the Committee for the Environment, Spatial Planning and Energy (CEATE) from late 2021; member of the Committee for Science, Education and Culture (CSEC) and the Control Committee (CdG). Second Vice-President of the Council of States (2021–2022).

role: Federal Councillor, Head of the Federal Department of Justice and Police (FDJP/DFJP)
description: Headed the Justice and Police department during her first year on the Federal Council, with responsibility for asylum and migration policy among others.

role: Federal Councillor, Head of the Federal Department of Home Affairs (FDHA/DFI)
description: Took over the Department of Home Affairs from Alain Berset on 1 January 2024, with responsibility for social insurance (AHV/AVS, occupational pensions), health and health insurance, culture, gender equality, statistics and meteorology.
